clips.title: The story
paras: Sentinel Selarin sends travelers south from Auberdine into Ashenvale. There, you report to Raene Wolfrunner in Astranaar, where the Sentinels face spreading corruption.

Sentinel Selarin's call for aid brings you from Auberdine, on Darkshore's somber gray coast, toward the night elf lands to the south. The Sentinel trusts capable fighters and scouts to make the journey into the heart of that territory. With local threats in Darkshore handled, the greater perils of Ashenvale now demand attention.

An ancient night elf road winds south beneath Ashenvale's dense canopy. Raene Wolfrunner, who leads the Sentinels in Astranaar, has urgently called for reinforcements. Demonic taints, rampant wildlife, and incursions from beyond ancestral lands have stretched the defenders thin. They need outside aid to hold the sacred forest.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Friend, my mistress, Raene Wolfrunner, awaits you in the city of Astranaar within Ashenvale. With your help, perhaps we can at least ease some of the corruption that's taken hold there.
Head south from here and stay close to the road--you'll find your way there without issue if you follow those directions.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Ah, an adventurer from Darkshore. Selarin has done well to send you here so quickly, friend. I wish your trip here wasn't under such dire stress. Perhaps with your help we can improve matters.
I would start my visit by speaking to the other citizens of Astranaar. Some could surely use your aid.

sources.title: Quest text as quoted on the Warcraft Wiki
